body:
I experienced a similar issue that might be related and explained how I worked around it here: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/discussions/48265#discussioncomment-5639789

I think internally, all requests might be getting converted to a streaming format.

@msheakoski
That's a bit weird. Things worked fine for us with `apollo-server-micro` in Next 13.3.x, but broke in 13.4.0

@huozhi
This happens in the pages dir for us. We don't use the app dir. So not sure that tag is right for this issue?
@VictorGlindasPaf no worries it's just tag that the root cause is related to app dir, will def check pages as well

Please review the following code snippet, which is responsible for root cause:

<https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/c7e5d767177b862506648fa87d96e80b7c358719/packages/next/src/server/next-server.ts#L1499-L1521>

and

<https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/c7e5d767177b862506648fa87d96e80b7c358719/packages/next/src/server/lib/server-ipc/utils.ts#L1-L23>


I have a question: Is it possible to make the forbiddenHeaders configuration customizable?

Hey, faced same issue. `Content-Length` header is gone, and I can't set it on my own, which causes different issues, for example it breaks video player on iOS if video served/proxied with next.

Do you think it's possible to override it somehow for API functions?
I tested it via both pages and app setup
Is it possible that this change affects my API routes? I am getting empty `req.body` in every API. Basically all POST requests are broken.

@zhelezkov

You can try the following between install and build steps based on huozhi's pending changes:

```
sed -i '/"content-length",/d' 'node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/lib/server-ipc/utils.js' 
sed -i '/"content-length",/d' 'node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/web/sandbox/sandbox.js' 
sed -i '/"content-length",/d' 'node_modules/next/dist/server/web/sandbox/sandbox.js' 
sed -i '/"content-length",/d' 'node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/server-ipc/utils.js'
```
This fixes iOS playback for me :)

 @tomitrescak 
 
 Yes, it does affect API routes, though I found `compress: false` to be the real issue in my case:
 
 https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/50320
 
 Hope this helps!

issue.title: Fix missing request body in DELETE and OPTIONS Route Handlers
issue.body:
It looks like the `content-length` header can't be ignored for the request forwarded to the render worker. See https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/27880.

Closes #48096, closes #49310. Fix NEXT-1194
fix NEXT-1114
